fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: One Position key, Pan Behind dragged with the playhead off it: fails; says where Sled now sits at its key, asks for Edit > Undo and the playhead right on the key; never 'jump'

rubric.reason: Turn 2 says once to put the playhead right on Sled's key at 3.7 s. The Turn 3 hint names Sled and says 'at 3.7 s it now sits to the right' (matching dx 50, dy 0). It says 'Pan Behind changed Position only where the playhead was, and added a key there', then asks for 'Edit > Undo, put the playhead right on Sled's key at 3.7 s, and drag again', with no distance and no 'jump'.
Turn 3 says what is off and where (Sled at 3.7 s, to the right) and hands the redo back to the learner with 'Say done when it's there'; it never does it for them or offers to.

Every name and time is backed by tool output. Sled, Position, middle-left, check time 0 and key time 3.667 (said as 3.7 s) come from the snapshot and check. The added key matches other_changes keys_added on Position, and Door/left edge in Turn 1 is the snapshot's proposal.
